# SOSCleanroom

> > SOSCleanroom is a master distributor of Texwipe and other cleanroom supplies, specializing in contamination control products for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and industrial cleanrooms.

Based in Dallas with 40+ years of experience, SOSCleanroom (Specialty Optical Systems, Inc.) provides cleanroom products, compliance guidance, and technical support for facilities operating under USP <795>/<797>/<800>, ISO 14644, and EU GMP Annex 1 standards. The company offers auto-shipment programs, product matching tools, and extensive educational resources for sterile compounding and contamination control.

## Key Topics

- Texwipe cleanroom products
- USP <797> sterile compounding
- USP <800> hazardous drug handling
- EU GMP Annex 1 compliance
- ISO 14644 cleanroom standards
- Contamination control
- Sterile compounding supplies
- Cleanroom wipes and swabs
- Aseptic technique
- Pharmaceutical cleanrooms
- Biotechnology cleanrooms
- Cleanroom garments and gloves
- Sporicides and disinfectants
- USP <795> non-sterile compounding
- Cleanroom classification
